description: Defines data structures and classes for representing resource element patterns within a resource grid, including re_pattern and re_pattern_list, with methods for constructing, merging, and masking patterns.

classes.name: re_pattern
classes.description: Represents a resource element pattern within a resource grid, including masks for resource blocks, resource elements, and symbols, with methods for inclusion and exclusion masking.

classes.name: re_pattern_list
classes.description: Manages a list of re_pattern objects, allowing merging, comparison, and masking operations for resource element patterns.

methods.name: get_inclusion_mask
methods.description: Includes the described resource elements in a symbol mask based on the pattern.

methods.name: get_exclusion_mask
methods.description: Excludes the described resource elements from a symbol mask based on the pattern.

methods.name: merge
methods.description: Merges another re_pattern or re_pattern_list into the current pattern or list.

methods.name: get_inclusion_count
methods.description: Counts included elements within a specified symbol range and resource block mask.
